caution_findings.evidence_context: Table 1 reports genus/species-group MIC ranges; database per-strain rows are preserved as group-supported but not exact per-strain primary measurements.
Primary source uses CnKKc12K OAK notation and synthesis/acyl/amide context, while merged database sequence rows encode generic KKXK/KXK.
Some database rows label biofilm killing as MBEC or use units/rows not stated by the selected paper; these remain source_conflict/database_only cases with locators.
Bactericidal and membrane-damage figure curves support qualitative/threshold claims, but exact plotted values were not extracted from images.
Local supplementary .bin assets were checked with file/head/rg and are duplicate article HTML landing pages, not parseable data tables.
